title: Splenomegaly

content_blocks.text: Enlargement of the spleen; characterized as either diffuse, focal, or nodular.

Splenic functions—removal of senescent and abnormal erythrocytes; filtration and phagocytosis of antigenic particles such as microorganisms, degraded cellular material, macromolecules; production of lymphocytes and plasma cells; antibody production, reservoir for erythrocytes and platelets; iron metabolism and storage,
